signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story house frontage; a large tree partially blocks the right-center facade.
signals.notes: Well-kept two-story colonial with siding and stone porch accents and a designed mulched bed with uniform shrubs and boulders around the front tree (possibly professionally installed, but no crew evidence); the garage is open with trash bins inside, a white SUV is in the driveway, and a silver car is parked at the curb.
